column1: •  A completed visit is the only thing that becomes revenue. A schedule printout counts visits that may never happen — delivered work is what pays.
•  When we misread capacity it shows up two ways: referrals we turn down (work we could have taken) and visits we miss (work we promised and didn’t deliver). Both cost money and reputation.
•  Reading capacity well means more admits we can safely say yes to, fewer missed visits, and steadier clinicians — the same headcount doing more, more calmly.
